notes.title: Version 0.3.5
notes.notes:
Project upgraded to Unity 2021.3 from 2019.4 to improve Unity's HDRP situation, as some testers were having difficulty launching the game. This should hopefully fix issues with game crashing at starting that seemed to occur randomly on some computers.

In addition to that, a "Just Quit" button added to Feedback Report.

Also, cockpit glass materials improved.
